 AG Uthemier announces arrest of Kissimmee Mayor Jackie Espinosa
 BY 
 Spectrum News Staff
 Osceola County 
 PUBLISHED 9:48 AM ET Oct. 21, 2026 
 PUBLISHED 9:48 AM EDT Oct. 21, 2026 
 SHARE 
 KISSIMMEE, Fla. — Florida Attorney General James Uthemier posted on X Wednesday morning that Kissimmee Mayor Jackie Espinosa has been arrested and charged with grand theft and organized scheme to defraud.
 No other information has been released surrounding the charges.
 Uthemier also noted on X that his office will hold a press conference at 2 p.m. from the Orlando office with Florida Chief Financial Officer Blaise Ingoglia and Florida Department of Law Enforcement Commissioner Larry Keefe.
